result.title: Adaptive Semantic Branching: Disagreement-Localized Cross-Trajectory Regeneration for Reasoning Candidate Expansion
result.summary: Reasoning trajectories generated for the same problem often arrive at conflicting answers. These disagreements reveal alternative intermediate decisions that can be reused to explore new solutions. We introduce Adaptive Semantic Branching (ASB), a training-free inference procedure that turns cross-trajectory disagreement into targeted candidate generation. ASB first groups independently sampled trajectories by extracted final answer, selects a representative from each group, and aligns their reasoning steps with a monotonic dynamic program. A persistent-divergence objective identifies the point at which initially similar reasoning paths develop different continuations. For each selected directed pair, ASB retains the source trajectory's textual prefix, extracts a short reasoning window from a competing donor trajectory, and generates a fresh solution conditioned on both. A diversity-aware policy allocates up to three additional generations according to the answer-cluster structure. In a 500-problem MATH evaluation with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, ASB increases oracle candidate coverage from 445/500 (89.0%) with seven initial samples to 455/500 (91.0%), recovering correct candidates for 10 of the 55 initially uncovered problems. The method uses 576 additional generation calls across the evaluation set, averaging 8.152 calls per problem. We provide a precise specification of the branching operator, alignment objective, generation policy, and experimental configuration.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Adaptive Semantic Branching：按最终答案对独立采样的文本推理轨迹分组，用单调动态规划对齐步骤，以「持续分歧」目标定位路径分叉点，再结合竞争轨迹的推理片段重新生成候选，并按答案簇结构分配至多三次额外生成；在 MATH 上以 oracle 覆盖率提升验证。该方法免训练。
AI.relevance_reason: 轨迹对齐与分歧点定位、分支式候选扩展、按簇多样性分配生成预算，可为 latent 推理轨迹的分支搜索、贡献分配与自适应计算/停止决策提供可核查的方法线索；但材料仅涉及纯文本 MATH，无视觉证据或内部状态，与 LVR 的联系需读原文判断。
